Centene on Wednesday reaffirmed its full-year adjusted diluted earnings per share guidance of greater than $4.80. Consensus is $4.89.
The company also said at the Deutsche Bank 2026 Healthcare conference that GAAP diluted EPS is projected at greater than $3.11.
CFO Drew Asher noted that Centene's Medicaid pre-tax margin is positive.
